aids.description_en: Contributory old-age pension under IVM (Invalidez, Vejez y Muerte) regime of CCSS. Minimum pension: 184,520 CRC/month in 2025. Age 65 (men) / 63 (women) with 300 months of contributions. Source: ccss.sa.cr.
aids.organisme: CCSS — Caja Costarricense del Seguro Social

aids.description_en: Means-tested conditional cash transfer of 40,000–90,000 CRC/month for extreme-poor households via FODESAF. Multiple programs channel this funding (IMAS, PANI). Source: fodesaf.go.cr.
aids.organisme: FODESAF — Fondo de Desarrollo Social y Asignaciones Familiares

aids.description_en: Conditional cash transfer of 21,000–125,000 CRC/month for secondary school students from poor families. Amount varies by school level. Conditionality: school attendance. Source: imas.go.cr.
aids.organisme: IMAS — Instituto Mixto de Ayuda Social

aids.description_en: One-time housing subsidy of 14–18 million CRC for purchase, construction or improvement of first home for low-income families. Administered by BANHVI (Banco Hipotecario de la Vivienda). Source: banhvi.fi.cr.
aids.organisme: BANHVI — Banco Hipotecario de la Vivienda

aids.description_en: Unemployment benefit of 50% of last wage for 3–6 months for formal workers covered by CCSS. Requires min. 3 months of contributions. Managed via FODESAF/CCSS. Source: ccss.sa.cr.

Disability pension of approx. 60% of average insured salary for workers with permanent disability under CCSS IVM regime. Requires medical certificate and min. 12 months of contributions. Source: ccss.sa.cr.
aids.organisme: CCSS — Caja Costarricense del Seguro Social

aids.description_en: Universal healthcare coverage via CCSS SEM (Seguro de Enfermedad y Maternidad). Compulsory for formal workers; voluntary for self-employed and informal. Public hospitals and EBAIS clinics free for SEM subscribers. Source: ccss.sa.cr.
aids.organisme: CCSS — Caja Costarricense del Seguro Social

aids.description_en: University scholarship of 40,000–90,000 CRC/month for students from low-income households. Renewable annually. Administered by FONABE (Fondo Nacional de Becas). Source: fonabe.go.cr.
